title: EPOWER Energy Intelligence — Complete Demo Wimmel Picture
description: Specification for generating a Wimmel-style illustration covering all 4 modules of the EPOWER Hands-On Lab. The picture visualizes EPOWER's business model as a German energy retailer and the Snowflake AI & Data Platform capabilities that power it.

format.style: Friendly, modern Wimmel-style (Wimmelbild) vector art with clean lines and vivid colors. Approachable, optimistic, slightly playful — like a tech company infographic crossed with a Where's Waldo scene. NOT overly futuristic or intimidating. People look happy, relaxed, collaborative. The AI agent is small, humble, and helpful — not dominant or scary.
format.mood: Positive, optimistic, grounded, fun. Shows technology serving people and the planet. The feeling of a thriving community powered by smart energy and intelligent data.

layout.description: The picture tells the story from left to right: Physical Energy World (left) → Snowflake Platform (center) → Business Operations & Applications (right). The bottom runs a data pipeline connecting everything. The top shows the intelligent agent serving users.

zones.top_center: Snowflake Intelligence Agent + natural language questions
zones.left: Physical energy world (homes, VPP, prosumers, grid)
zones.right: Business operations (HQ, portal, apps, control room)
zones.bottom: Data pipelines, integrations, and operational flows

center_hub.title: Snowflake AI & Data Platform
center_hub.description: Large central hub representing Snowflake — the data and AI brain of EPOWER. Structured as three visible layers stacked like floors.

elements.name: Bronze Layer
elements.visual: Copper/brown tinted floor with raw data flowing in — CSV files, IoT sensor streams, API data, PDF documents landing
elements.label: Raw Ingestion

elements.name: Silver Layer
elements.visual: Silver/grey tinted floor with dbt logo, data being cleaned, filtered, enriched, joined
elements.label: Cleaning & Transformation

elements.name: Gold Layer
elements.visual: Gold tinted floor with polished charts, KPIs, semantic models glowing with structure
elements.label: Business-Ready Analytics

top_center_agent.title: EPOWER Intelligence Agent
top_center_agent.description: A friendly, humble, small AI assistant figure sitting on top of the Snowflake hub. NOT a large intimidating robot — more like a helpful librarian or concierge. Approachable, smiling, with small tool icons around it.
top_center_agent.visual_guidelines: Small figure, warm colors, open posture, NOT glowing eyes or laser beams. Think friendly neighborhood helper, not sci-fi overlord.

elements.name: Natural Language Questions

elements.name: Semantic Views (left arm/tool)

elements.name: Cortex Search (right arm/tool)

business_value_narrative.description: The picture should tell the story of business value, not just technology. Each zone demonstrates a business outcome enabled by Snowflake.

value_stories.business_value: Customers earn money from their batteries. EPOWER gets recurring revenue. Grid becomes more stable.
value_stories.snowflake_enabler: Real-time IoT analytics + price optimization via dbt pipelines

value_stories.business_value: Any employee can get insights instantly — no waiting for analyst reports, no SQL skills needed.
value_stories.snowflake_enabler: Cortex Agent + Semantic Views + Cortex Search

value_stories.business_value: Operational data instantly available for analytics — no ETL pipelines to build or maintain.
New data sources onboarded in minutes, not days. Data team velocity dramatically increased.
Custom applications built on Agent REST API — embed intelligence anywhere.
value_stories.snowflake_enabler: Cortex Agent REST API + Container Runtime

value_stories.scene: MCP server connecting to external tools
value_stories.business_value: EPOWER's data intelligence accessible from any AI tool — Claude, Cursor, VS Code.

do_not_include: Scary or intimidating AI imagery (no glowing red eyes, no Terminator vibes)
Generic cloud computing imagery without business context
Abstract data visualizations without connection to energy domain
Overly complex technical diagrams that look like architecture documents
Any elements unrelated to energy retail / Snowflake AI narrative
References to 'two-phase' or 'heuristic' telemetry — all VPP data is price-reactive
Competitors' logos or branding (except subtle real-world VPP references: 1KOMMA5, Sonnen)

generation_notes.prompt_style: Use this JSON as a structured brief for image generation AI (DALL-E, Midjourney, Gemini Imagen). Convert the relevant sections into a natural language prompt, emphasizing the mood, layout, and key scenes.
generation_notes.iterations: The picture may need 2-3 iterations. First get the layout and mood right, then refine labels and details.
generation_notes.resolution: Target 3840x2160 (4K) for print quality, export at 1920x1080 for web/README use.
